Tip 1: If the system won't power on and the fans don't spin, verify the motherboard power and CPU power connections, confirm CPU and memory model compatibility and condition, and ensure the memory modules are properly seated; if the issue persists after checking these, clear the CMOS

Tip 2: If there's no display (fans spin but keyboard lights remain unresponsive when pressing Caps Lock), verify the motherboard and CPU power connections, ensure memory modules are properly seated, and confirm CPU/memory model compatibility and condition; if issues persist after these checks, clear CMOS

Tip 3: If there's no display (fans are spinning and the Caps Lock indicator lights up when pressing Caps Lock), verify the monitor is powered on and the display data cable is securely connected; check the condition of the display cable, GPU, and monitor; if the issue persists after these checks, clear CMOS

description:
Overview

Does your high-performance build require additional CPU power? Are you building with a Corsair modular power supply and need a dedicated CPU cable? This 8-pin male to 4+4 pin male EPS-12V adapter cable is the perfect solution for providing clean, dedicated power to your motherboard's CPU socket .

Designed exclusively for Corsair modular power supplies, this cable bridges the gap between your PSU's CPU output port and your motherboard's EPS-12V power connector, ensuring your processor receives stable, reliable power for overclocking and demanding workloads .

Why You Need This Cable

Many modern motherboards—especially those designed for overclocking—often require more CPU power than a single 4-pin connector can provide. High-end boards frequently feature 8-pin or even 8+4-pin CPU power configurations . This cable allows you to:

Add a second CPU power cable for motherboards with dual EPS-12V connectors

Replace a lost or damaged cable from your Corsair PSU kit

Extend your existing CPU power reach for better cable management in larger cases

Ensure stable power delivery during overclocking sessions or under heavy CPU loads

Versatile 4+4 Detachable Design

The motherboard end of this cable features an innovative detachable 4+4 pin design. This means :

Slide together for use as a standard 8-pin EPS-12V connector (compatible with most modern motherboards)

Separate into two 4-pin sections for use as a 4-pin ATX connector (compatible with older or entry-level boards)

No adapters needed—simply configure the connector to match your motherboard's requirements

Premium Build Quality

Conductor: High-purity 18AWG tinned copper wire ensures maximum conductivity and minimal power loss, supporting high-current CPU loads

Insulation: Durable PVC insulation with UL1007 rating provides excellent protection against heat and abrasion

Connectors: Precision-molded 8-pin male (PSU end) and 4+4 detachable male (motherboard end) connectors ensure secure, tight fit with no wobbling or loose connections

Length: 25 inches (63cm) including connectors—optimized for comfortable routing in most PC cases

Technical Specifications

⚠️ CRITICAL COMPATIBILITY AND SAFETY WARNINGS

1. CPU CABLE ONLY – NOT FOR GRAPHICS CARDS
This cable is designed specifically for CPU/motherboard power. It is NOT compatible with graphics cards . PCI-E 8-pin GPU cables have a different pin configuration and are not interchangeable. Using this cable for a graphics card will cause short circuits and permanent damage.

2. CORSAIR PSUs ONLY – NOT FOR EVGA OR OTHER BRANDS
This cable is engineered exclusively for Corsair modular power supplies listed above. It is NOT compatible with :v
EVGA power supplies (will cause damage)

Other brands (Seasonic, Thermaltake, Cooler Master, etc.) without verification

Older Corsair models not listed (e.g., AX1200 non-"i")v
3. VERIFY YOUR PSU MODEL
Before purchasing, please locate the model number on your power supply's label and confirm it appears in the compatibility list . Connecting this cable to an incompatible PSU will result in:

Short circuits

Motherboard damage

Component failure

Voided warranties

4. INSTALLATION PRECAUTIONS
